name: s_curve
description: Continuous forward locomotion with alternating yaw rate (S-curve path) testing combined forward and rotational tracking.
notes: min_path_length_m derivation: the trot commands ask for |v| = 0.30 m/s for 3.0 s + 3.0 s = 6.0 s, so a base that follows them accumulates ~1.8 m of cumulative travel (the actual curve is slightly longer than the straight-line sum). A stationary base accumulates ~0 m. The gate requires 50% of that ideal (0.9 m) to absorb the start-up transient while remaining unreachable without real motion.
